Mike Nuttall Header
MikeNuttall## Mike Nuttall
### Tenure
1970–1978
1999–2016
### Title
Lead Designer, Premium
**Michael Wayne Nuttall**is a master of toy design. Known by his peers as "Track Master Mike" he has pretty much seen it all, done it all, etc. He can whip out a great concept sketch faster than most people can pick up their pen. He worked at Mattel's Hot Wheels division from 1999 to 2016; he is currently a member of InvenToy, a company started by former Hot Wheels engineersEric OstendorffandKeith Hippely. Prior to his stint at Hot Wheels, he worked for Mattel's Preschool division from 1970 to 1978 before moving to competing brand Tomy.
